gen-gf-unica-one-gf-kadwa: Kadwa moves along in open-ended curves with a generous x-height, a text serif with a classic, editorial pull. But Unica One is the surprise, commanding and display-bold, with no calligraphic modulation and every stroke the same weight.
gen-gf-unica-one-gf-noticia-text: Unica One has an enormous lowercase eye and visible daylight inside every curve, giving its commanding display letters a single-thread feel. Noticia Text, a dignified classic serif, lets paragraphs unspool with a literary hush.
gen-gf-unica-one-gf-piazzolla: Refined, almost sternly so, Piazzolla is a text serif whose lowercase nearly matches its capitals. And Unica One handles the loud, commanding job up top while Piazzolla handles the steady work of the text.
gen-gf-unica-one-gf-pridi: Pridi stands tall, its small letters almost capital-sized. Against that classic serif, Unica One brings a commanding display voice, with a huge lowercase eye and daylight inside every curve.
gen-gf-unica-one-gf-scope-one: Unica One has a huge lowercase eye and no variation in stroke thickness, so its display letters feel commanding. Scope One, a refined serif, spills its counters into open space.
gen-gf-unica-one-gf-slabo-13px: Big-eyed and loud, Unica One has no swelling mid-curve, just daylight inside every curve. Slabo 13px, a bookish text serif whose tall letters have large open counters, makes a dignified partner.
gen-gf-unkempt-gf-bhutuka-expanded-one: Expressive and commanding, Unkempt takes the lead up top. Its t keeps crossbar and stem at matching weight, while BhuTuka Expanded One, a serif with curvy, unclamped letters, slows the pace to a leisurely walk.
gen-gf-unkempt-gf-stint-ultra-expanded: Stint Ultra Expanded is a text serif whose characters float apart, each letterform with a pipe-cleaner feel and open counters. Unkempt, expressive and commanding, keeps its t crossbar and stem matched.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-epunda-slab: Epunda Slab is a dignified classic serif with a visibly gaping c and tall, rounded lowercase forms. But Wallpoet is bold and commanding, with paper showing through between its letters, which makes the two feel pleasingly mismatched.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-glegoo: Glegoo is a refined, editorial serif with big counters and curved letters that keep wide, unclosed mouths. But Wallpoet, bold and commanding, leads with its high-rising lowercase, and text underneath moves along with an open, unhurried feel.
